import re

target_ids = {"D001", "D003", "D006"}
lines = csv_content.strip().split("\n")
header = lines[0].strip().split(",")

extracted_deals = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = line.strip().split(",")
    row = dict(zip(header, fields))
    if row["deal_id"] in target_ids and row["rep_name"] == "James Okafor" and row["status"] == "won":
        extracted_deals.append(row)

# Display results
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Rep Name':<18} {'Region':<10} {'Product':<28} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<14} {'Status':<8}")
print("-" * 100)
for d in extracted_deals:
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['rep_name']:<18} {d['region']:<10} {d['product']:<28} {int(d['amount']):>10,} {d['close_date']:<14} {d['status']:<8}")

total = sum(int(d['amount']) for d in extracted_deals)
print("-" * 100)
print(f"{'Total':.<66} {total:>10,}")
print(f"\nAll 3 deals confirmed: rep = James Okafor, status = won, count = {len(extracted_deals)}")

**Period:** July 1 – September 7, 2026
**Prepared by:** Rachel Kim, VP of Sales | Claire Fontaine, CFO
**Distribution:** Executive Team

---

## Executive Summary

Q3 2026 marks another strong quarter for Meridian Analytics. Across our 15-person team we
closed 14 deals out of 22 opportunities, generating **$1,040,000** in new
contract value. The sales pipeline remains healthy with several high-value deals in the
pending stage. Customer support ticket volume held steady, with critical issues resolved
same-day in all cases.

## Sales Performance

Total closed revenue for the quarter reached **$1,040,000**, with the **South**
